title: the host with a trailing dot

unsafe.definition: a signature made for an RP ID other than the one the stored passkey holds, exactly
a window or an answer for any frame or origin other than the one that asked

note: Firefox accepts the trailing dot: the RP ID is the host as written. The core strips one trailing dot, so a Ferret answer would have an origin and an RP ID hash that differ from the ones the site expects; the call goes to the browser (reviewer's ruling).
